title: Extract and Classify Contract Clauses
description:
At a legal tech company, lawyers need to review hundreds of vendor contracts. Your pipeline receives raw contract text and must:

1. Identify each distinct clause
2. Classify it into one of: indemnification, limitation_of_liability, termination, confidentiality, payment_terms, intellectual_property, warranty, force_majeure, governing_law, data_protection, non_compete, other
3. Extract key terms from each clause (monetary limits, time periods, conditions)
4. Flag any clauses that are unusually risky (one-sided indemnification, unlimited liability, auto-renewal with >30 day notice, non-compete >2 years)

Output a JSON array of clause objects to stdout. Each must have: clause_type, text_excerpt (first 100 chars), key_terms (object), risk_flag (boolean), risk_reason (string or null).

The contracts mix legalese, defined terms, cross-references, and deliberately vague language. Some clauses span multiple paragraphs.
company_context: Legal tech companies like Ironclad, DocuSign, and Kira Systems process millions of contracts. Manual contract review takes 2-4 hours per document and costs $200-500 in lawyer time. AI-powered clause extraction reduces review time by 60% while catching risky terms that humans miss under time pressure.

skip_conditions: Contracts with status 'SUPERSEDED', 'VOID', or 'DRAFT — NOT EXECUTED' must be excluded entirely from output
Clauses within an EXHIBIT or SCHEDULE section that are explicitly marked '[SAMPLE LANGUAGE — NOT PART OF AGREEMENT]' must be excluded
Contracts marked as templates or form agreements (e.g., '[TEMPLATE]', 'FORM AGREEMENT') must be excluded
amendment_rules: When an amendment is present alongside its base contract, the amendment's terms OVERRIDE the corresponding clauses in the base contract
Only output the FINAL effective version of each clause after applying all amendments
If an amendment explicitly strikes/deletes a clause, exclude that clause from output entirely

risk_assessment_rules.one_sided_indemnification: Flag if one party has broad indemnification obligations and the other has narrow or no obligations
risk_assessment_rules.liability_cap_below_12_months: Flag if liability cap is less than 12 months of fees (3 months, 6 months, etc.)
risk_assessment_rules.auto_renewal_notice: Flag if non-renewal notice period exceeds 30 days
risk_assessment_rules.non_compete_duration: Flag if non-compete extends beyond 24 months post-termination
risk_assessment_rules.unlimited_liability: Flag if either party has uncapped liability for any obligation category
risk_assessment_rules.termination_penalty: Flag if termination requires payment of remaining contract fees or significant early termination penalty
risk_assessment_rules.unilateral_ip_assignment: Flag if IP assignment is unilateral (only flows one direction for jointly developed work)
risk_assessment_rules.broad_force_majeure: Flag if force majeure definition includes subjective events like 'business hardship' or 'market conditions'
risk_assessment_rules.data_retention_over_5_years: Flag if data retention or confidentiality period exceeds 5 years or is perpetual

output_rules.text_excerpt: First 100 characters of the clause text (including section number)
output_rules.key_terms: Extract ALL quantitative terms (durations, monetary amounts, percentages, notice periods) plus scope/applicability qualifiers
output_rules.combine_subsections: Clause subsections (e.g., 4.1, 4.2, 4.3) under the same section heading should be combined into ONE clause object with all key_terms aggregated

MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
Between: TechVendor Solutions Inc. ("Provider") and ClientCorp LLC ("Client")
Effective Date: January 1, 2024

4. PAYMENT TERMS
4.1 Client shall pay Provider the fees set forth in each Statement of Work within forty-five (45) days of receipt of invoice. Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is less.
4.2 Provider reserves the right to suspend Services if any invoice remains unpaid for more than sixty (60) days. Client shall reimburse Provider for all reasonable costs of collection, including attorneys' fees.
4.3 Fees shall increase automatically by 8% on each anniversary of the Effective Date unless Client provides written notice of objection at least ninety (90) days prior to such anniversary.

5. INDEMNIFICATION
5.1 Client shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Provider and its officers, directors, employees, agents, and affiliates from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to: (a) Client's use of the Services; (b) Client's breach of this Agreement; (c) any claim by a third party relating to Client's products or services; or (d) Client's negligence or willful misconduct.
5.2 Provider's indemnification obligations shall be limited to claims arising directly from Provider's gross negligence or willful misconduct in performing the Services.

6. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
6.1 IN NO EVENT SHALL PROVIDER'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE FEES PAID BY CLIENT IN THE THREE (3) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
6.2 IN NO EVENT SHALL PROVIDER BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, REGARDLESS OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION.
6.3 The limitations set forth in this Section 6 shall not apply to Client's indemnification obligations under Section 5 or Client's payment obligations under Section 4.

7. TERM AND TERMINATION
7.1 This Agreement shall have an initial term of three (3) years from the Effective Date and shall automatically renew for successive one (1) year periods unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least one-hundred-twenty (120) days prior to the end of the then-current term.
7.2 Provider may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice if Client breaches any material term and fails to cure within ten (10) days. Client may terminate only at the end of a term per Section 7.1.
7.3 Upon termination by Client, Client shall pay all fees due through the end of the then-current term, including fees for any uncommenced Statement of Work.

8. NON-COMPETE
8.1 During the term of this Agreement and for a period of thirty-six (36) months following termination, Client shall not, directly or indirectly, develop, market, or sell any product or service that competes with the Services provided hereunder.

9. CONFIDENTIALITY
9.1 Each party shall hold in strict confidence all Confidential Information of the other party. "Confidential Information" means any information designated as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given the nature of the information and circumstances of disclosure.
9.2 Confidentiality obligations shall survive for five (5) years following termination of this Agreement.

10. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
10.1 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict of laws principles.
10.2 Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be resolved exclusively through binding arbitration in Wilmington, Delaware, under the rules of the American Arbitration Association.

SOFTWARE LICENSE AND SERVICES AGREEMENT
Between: DataFlow Analytics Ltd. ("Licensor") and Meridian Health Systems ("Licensee")
Effective Date: February 15, 2024

3. LICENSE GRANT AND INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
3.1 Licensor hereby grants Licensee a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Software during the term of this Agreement solely for Licensee's internal business purposes.
3.2 All intellectual property rights in the Software, including any modifications, enhancements, or derivative works, shall remain the exclusive property of Licensor, regardless of whether such modifications were requested or funded by Licensee.
3.3 Any custom integrations, reports, or configurations developed jointly by the parties during implementation shall be owned exclusively by Licensor, who grants Licensee a perpetual, royalty-free license to use such works solely in connection with the Software.

4. DATA PROTECTION AND PRIVACY
4.1 Licensor shall process Licensee's data solely for the purpose of providing the Services and in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including but not limited to HIPAA, as Licensee operates in the healthcare sector.
4.2 Licensor shall implement and maintain appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect Personal Health Information (PHI) in accordance with the Business Associate Agreement executed concurrently herewith.
4.3 Upon termination, Licensor shall retain Licensee's data for a period of seven (7) years for regulatory compliance purposes, after which it shall be securely destroyed. Licensee may request an export of its data at any time during this period.
4.4 Licensor shall notify Licensee within twenty-four (24) hours of discovering any data breach involving Licensee's data.

5. WARRANTY AND REPRESENTATIONS
5.1 Licensor warrants that the Software shall perform substantially in accordance with the documentation for a period of ninety (90) days following each delivery (the "Warranty Period").
5.2 EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN SECTION 5.1, THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND LICENSOR MAKES NO OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, OR NON-INFRINGEMENT.
5.3 Licensee's exclusive remedy for breach of the warranty in Section 5.1 shall be, at Licensor's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Software.

6. FORCE MAJEURE
6.1 Neither party shall be liable for any failure or delay in performing its obligations under this Agreement to the extent such failure or delay results from circumstances beyond the reasonable control of that party, including but not limited to: acts of God, natural disasters, war, terrorism, epidemics, government actions, labor disputes, power failures, internet or telecommunications failures, cyberattacks, or any other event that could not have been reasonably foreseen or prevented.
6.2 The affected party shall provide notice within forty-eight (48) hours and use commercially reasonable efforts to mitigate the impact. If a force majeure event continues for more than ninety (90) days, either party may terminate this Agreement without penalty.

7. INDEMNIFICATION
7.1 Licensor shall indemnify Licensee against claims that the Software infringes any valid United States patent or copyright, provided Licensee promptly notifies Licensor and grants Licensor sole control of the defense.
7.2 Licensee shall indemnify Licensor against all claims arising from Licensee's use of the Software in violation of applicable law, Licensee's combination of the Software with non-approved third-party systems, or Licensee's failure to implement security measures recommended by Licensor.

8. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
8.1 EXCEPT FOR INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS AND BREACHES OF DATA PROTECTION OBLIGATIONS, NEITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY SHALL EXCEED TWO TIMES (2X) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
8.2 NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES.

9. TERM AND TERMINATION
9.1 Initial term of five (5) years. Auto-renews for successive two (2) year periods unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least one-hundred-eighty (180) days prior to expiration.
9.2 Either party may terminate for material breach with sixty (60) days written notice and opportunity to cure.
9.3 Licensee may terminate for convenience with twelve (12) months prior written notice, subject to payment of an early termination fee equal to fifty percent (50%) of the remaining fees for the then-current term.

10. GOVERNING LAW
10.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California. Disputes shall be resolved by litigation in the state or federal courts located in San Francisco County.
